title: BambooHR Review (2026)
intro: BambooHR is evaluated here as a core HRIS / employee system of record — BambooHR is a core HRIS for employee records, hiring/onboarding, PTO, performance, and employee experience. Published Core/Pro/Elite PEPM is $10 / $17 / $25 per employee/month above 25 employees; teams of 25 or fewer start from a $250/mo flat floor. US payroll, benefits admin, time & attendance, and global employment are add-ons. ATS job-opening caps scale by plan (5 / 25 / 50). This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose BambooHR when you need a clean SMB/mid-market core HRIS with published PEPM — not when the primary job is high-volume ATS, frontline scheduling, or enterprise HCM.
verdict: Choose BambooHR when you need a clean SMB/mid-market core HRIS with published PEPM — not when the primary job is high-volume ATS, frontline scheduling, or enterprise HCM. Compare Rippling for HR+IT+payroll on one platform, Gusto for US SMB payroll-first buying, Greenhouse or Breezy HR for dedicated ATS, and Workday for enterprise HCM. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: BambooHR is the default SMB/mid HRIS shortlist name for a clean people admin UI. Score reflects first-party positioning, not hands-on lab testing.
Primary job is core HRIS (employee system of record). Scored inside hris-core, not against ATS, WFM, or payroll-only peers. Built-in hiring is a module with opening caps.
Employee records, PTO, onboarding, and performance workflows are the HRIS core. Payroll/time depth lives on add-ons — held at 8 vs full people platforms.
150+ marketplace connectors including Slack and payroll/benefits carriers; native depth is stronger as an HRIS hub than as a payroll engine.
Employee self-service mobile exists; this is not a deskless WFM/comms product. Scored for HRIS mobility, not shift ops.
HR reporting and AI insights are marketed on paid tiers; adequate for SMB/mid people analytics, not enterprise HCM BI.
Clear Core → Pro → Elite PEPM plus small-team floor supports growth into mid-market; not an enterprise HCM path.
Transparent PEPM floors are a strength; add-ons and the $250 small-team floor raise real TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
Bamboo AI / Ask BambooHR is a published assistant with tiered packaging — useful, not unlimited included AI.
